refs: Psa 60:1 , David, complaining to God of former judgment
Psa 60:4 , now upon better hope, prays for deliverance
Psa 60:6 , Comforting himself in God's promises, he craves that help whereon he trusts.

0.body:
Psa 60:1 , David, complaining to God of former judgment
Psa 60:4 , now upon better hope, prays for deliverance;
Psa 60:6 , Comforting himself in God's promises, he craves that help whereon he trusts.
Probably a hexachord harp, or lute; for aiduth appears to be the same as the Arabic ood , a harp or lute; concerning shushan .
